_doc: Culinary-to-Federal crosswalk: Cost Index ingredient slugs -> US Census HS6 import commodity codes. Every code is VERIFIED against the Census I_COMMODITY_SDESC returned in data/census-imports-2025.jsonl (the description must match the ingredient). US Census general-imports data is public domain. HS6 is the finest public aggregation; some codes combine related items (noted). This is a descriptive reference of the US import stream — never a delivered/retail price, never import VOLUME (quantity is not published at HS6), never a forecast.
_source: US Census Bureau, International Trade, general imports by HS6 (api.census.gov/data/timeseries/intltrade/imports/hs). Public domain.
